_comment: Dispatch round 4 client-construction sweep: a copy of dc-timer-states.json run with CHIRPSTACK_API_KEY empty on both sides. Record with OSI_ORACLE_NODE=edge/harness/scenarios/dispatch/oracle-nokey-node.sh and replay Go through a wrapper that runs `exec env CHIRPSTACK_API_KEY= <osi-edge> "$@"`. Covers one-time, clock and 06:00 ticks: the one-time and clock ticks use lazyTransport (rows written, the enqueue rejects with chirpstack_transport_unavailable, phase UNKNOWN; the tick goes on); the 06:00 open goes through the encoder. Original note: Dispatch-inventory probe: timer refusals. A ONCE schedule 30 minutes late (grace cutoff), a clock sync whose previous push is still queued, a SKIP_TODAY from an earlier day, and a 06:00 open on a valve held by a reserved conditional occurrence.
